system.description:
Excessive, protective, and direct, El Caballero tackles things head-on. He is prone to grand gestures and taking a stand.

Name

Choose a name from one of these lists, or make up your own:

  • Dolores, Guadalupe, Lourdes, Malena, Raquel.

  • Álvaro, Domingo, José, Lorenzo, Mariano

Look

Choose at least one option from each list:

  • Smoothed hair, ragged hair, shaved hair, cascading hair .

  • Sharp eyes, angry eyes, tired eyes, searching eyes.

  • Casual clothes, professional clothes, uniform clothes, protective clothes

Your Question

  • Are you handling things straightforwardly and without guile?

Relationships

  • ______ is the person you go to when you're stuck. They have seen your softer side.

  • ______ knew you when you used to get in trouble. They have seen your harder side.

Conditions

  • Engrossed: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love}.

  • Cornered: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.ZG3GSRjBqIiTmB0Z]{act desperately}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.TcWPAx8tGRie1Sb6]{demand what you deserve}.

  • Vicious: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{strike out}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.wQO9aJp5sChjcoUG]{process your feelings}.

  • Condemning: +1 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.bJci1vpORz3rIoW4]{accuse someone of lying to}, -2 to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.3EdfFL5zzGRV5Oxt]{manipulate a superior}.

Meltdown

There's a line between justice and vengeance. Sometimes. That's done now. You go directly to the object of your enmity and bring them that justice. You throw their sins in their face and mete out punishment. Maybe you lock them up in a jail or a cellar. Maybe you finish things once
and for all. Tomorrow they'll know you've always been a brute...but tonight they'll face you and know truth.

Last Time On

At the beginning of each episode, choose one from the list below and cross it off. Once all are gone, it's time for the series finale.

  • You got into a scrap that you barely got out of alive.

  • You uncovered a letter that ties you deeply to someone.

  • You bare-handedly touched a weapon that has since gone missing.

  • You agreed to work with the authorities to trick someone.

  • You spilled a piece of your sordid past, tears in your eyes

  • You spotted two people embracing through a window.

  • You put in some hard work to get something fixed.

Moves

CHOOSE TWO.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks.Item.6ppaFljuWNHLcskx]{Grand Gesture}

When you @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.w4NFPGL4Kx8TtRfn]{express your love passionately}, add the question "Are you making this absurdly elaborate and excessive?" to the list of questions. If your target gives themselves to you or tells you they love you, clear a condition.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks.Item.y7fZ5irSzR0l2IrX]{Size Up}

When you try to @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.iev5oXkeRFpO0Mgi]{spot something out of place}, ask one of these questions, even on a miss (6-):

  • Where is the nearest weapon?
  • What are they trying to hide?
  • What's their way out?

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks.Item.BG4qMIrOHxACbRK4]{For Your Protection}

When you offer your protection to someone and they accept, hold 1. You may spend that hold to appear in a scene with them at any time or move to exactly where you need to be to protect them before anyone can interfere.

@UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.playbooks.Item.yU2ogGDUKNuJnelc]{Take a Stand}

When you step in to defend someone, roll with the questions:

  • Are you trying to impress them?

  • Is the law being broken?

On a 7-9, hold 1. On a 10+, hold 3. While you stand in their defense, you may spend hold one-for-one to:

  • Protect them from an attack; take the hit instead of them.

  • Keep someone from leaving a room unless they go through you.

  • Take +1 on @UUID[Compendium.pasion-de-las-pasiones.moves.Item.C9GvWd6IY5KcAgSI]{striking out with violence} against someone who threatens harm.

On a miss (6-), you show your hand too soon; you're at their mercy, and the aggressor can inflict a condition on you or the target.
